spec: Same five-level ladder as the regional-language tool (letter, word, paragraph, story) so one engine and one dashboard serve every language. ASER's own English tool uses a different ladder (capital letters, small letters, words, sentences); this deviation is stated in the README. Letters: lowercase, 5 per card, letter name or sound both accepted. Words: familiar 3-letter CVC words, 5 per card. Paragraph: 4 linked sentences of at most 6 words. Story: 7-10 linked sentences. Original text written for LevelOS.

letter.hi: इन अंग्रेज़ी अक्षरों को एक-एक करके पढ़ो।
letter.mr: ही इंग्रजी अक्षरे एक-एक करून वाच.
letter.bn: এই ইংরেজি অক্ষরগুলো একটা একটা করে পড়ো।
letter.en: Read these letters one by one.

word.hi: इन अंग्रेज़ी शब्दों को एक-एक करके पढ़ो।
word.mr: हे इंग्रजी शब्द एक-एक करून वाच.
word.bn: এই ইংরেজি শব্দগুলো একটা একটা করে পড়ো।
word.en: Read these words one by one.

paragraph.hi: इसे ज़ोर से पढ़ो। उँगली रखकर पढ़ सकते हो।
paragraph.mr: हे मोठ्याने वाच. बोट ठेवून वाचले तरी चालेल.
paragraph.kn: ಇದನ್ನು ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಓದು. ಬೆರಳು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಓದಬಹುದು.
paragraph.ta: இதை உரக்கப் படி. விரலை வைத்துப் படிக்கலாம்.
paragraph.bn: এটা জোরে পড়ো। আঙুল রেখে পড়তে পারো।
paragraph.en: Read this aloud. You can keep your finger on the words.

items.title: My red ball
sentences: I have a red ball.
I play with it every day.
My dog likes my ball.
He runs after it.

items.title: A hot day
sentences: It is a hot day.
Ravi drinks cold water.
He sits under a tree.
A bird sings on the tree.

items.title: Meena's garden
sentences: Meena has a little garden.
She grows red tomatoes and green beans.
Every morning she waters the plants.
One day she saw a small rabbit.
The rabbit was eating her beans.
Meena did not shout at the rabbit.
She gave it a carrot instead.
Now the rabbit comes to visit every day.

items.title: Arjun's kite
sentences: Arjun wanted to fly a kite.
His sister helped him make one.
They used paper, sticks and string.
The wind was strong on the roof.
The kite went up high in the sky.
Suddenly the string broke.
The kite flew away over the trees.
Arjun laughed and said, "We will make another one."
